facts.text: Backshell and Parachute was deployed at Gusev Crater during Spirit (MER-A) in 2004.

Spirit's backshell and parachute landed about 300 metres from the rover. The airbag-enclosed lander bounced 28 times before coming to rest. These entry, descent, and landing components remain on the Martian surface as testament to the engineering that delivered Spirit safely to Gusev Crater.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
No direct science, but the EDL hardware demonstrates the airbag landing technology that delivered two rovers safely to Mars.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Gusev Crater.
The backshell and parachute remain on the surface about 300 metres from Spirit's landing site, visible in orbital imagery.
